source:
# EUR/GBP Divergence Strategy (EUR/USD vs GBP/USD Momentum)
# Trades EUR/GBP based on relative strength divergence between EUR/USD and GBP/USD

# Main data source for EUR/GBP (trading asset)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Reference FX pairs for divergence calculation
eurusd_src = fx_pairs(ticker="EURUSD")()
gbpusd_src = fx_pairs(ticker="GBPUSD")()

eurusd_close = eurusd_src.c
gbpusd_close = gbpusd_src.c

# =============================================================================
# DIVERGENCE CALCULATION
# =============================================================================

# Rate of Change momentum (14-period)
roc_eurusd = roc(period=14)(eurusd_close)
roc_gbpusd = roc(period=14)(gbpusd_close)

# Divergence: EUR/USD momentum minus GBP/USD momentum
# Positive = EUR strengthening relative to GBP
# Negative = GBP strengthening relative to EUR
divergence = roc_eurusd - roc_gbpusd

# Z-score of divergence (20-period rolling)
divergence_zscore = zscore(window=20)(divergence)

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Long EUR/GBP: z-score crosses above +1.0 (EUR/USD strengthening)
long_entry = crossover(divergence_zscore, 1.0)

# Short EUR/GBP: z-score crosses below -1.0 (GBP/USD strengthening)
short_entry = crossunder(divergence_zscore, -1.0)

# =============================================================================
# EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Exit long: z-score crosses below 0 (mean reversion) OR crosses below -0.5 (reversal)
long_exit_mean_revert = crossunder(divergence_zscore, 0.0)
long_exit_reversal = crossunder(divergence_zscore, -0.5)
long_exit = long_exit_mean_revert or long_exit_reversal

# Exit short: z-score crosses above 0 (mean reversion) OR crosses above +0.5 (reversal)
short_exit_mean_revert = crossover(divergence_zscore, 0.0)
short_exit_reversal = crossover(divergence_zscore, 0.5)
short_exit = short_exit_mean_revert or short_exit_reversal

# =============================================================================
# POSITION MANAGEMENT
# =============================================================================

# Hold signals for zone executors
long_held = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=long_exit)
short_held = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=short_exit)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_held, short_entry=short_held)

# =============================================================================
# RISK MANAGEMENT - INVERSE VOLATILITY SIZING
# =============================================================================

# 20-day ATR for EUR/GBP volatility
atr_20 = atr(period=20)()

# Rolling average ATR for normalization (50-day)
avg_atr = sma(period=50)(atr_20)

# Inverse volatility weight: lower volatility = larger position
# Scale factor: when ATR equals avg_atr, weight = 1.0
# When ATR > avg_atr (high vol), weight < 1.0
# When ATR < avg_atr (low vol), weight > 1.0
inv_vol_weight = avg_atr / atr_20

# Cap the weight to prevent excessive sizing (0.5 to 2.0 range)
capped_weight = 0.5 if inv_vol_weight < 0.5 else (2.0 if inv_vol_weight > 2.0 else inv_vol_weight)

# Base position size 10%, scaled by inverse volatility
base_size = 10.0
position_weight = base_size * capped_weight

# Combined signal: positive for long, negative for short, zero for flat
signal = 1.0 if long_held else (-1.0 if short_held else 0.0)
final_size = signal * position_weight

# Position sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=final_size)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Long entry marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Long Entry",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD ROC", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD ROC", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(divergence_zscore, roc_eurusd, roc_gbpusd, long_entry)

# Short entry marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Short Entry",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD ROC", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD ROC", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(divergence_zscore, roc_eurusd, roc_gbpusd, short_entry)

# Exit marker (both long and short exits)
any_exit = long_exit or short_exit
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Exit Signal",
        icon=Icon.XCircleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Revert Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Reversal Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(divergence_zscore, long_exit_mean_revert or short_exit_mean_revert, long_exit_reversal or short_exit_reversal, any_exit)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD VISUALIZATIONS
# =============================================================================

# Z-Score timeseries with threshold lines
timeseries_lines(
    title="Divergence Z-Score",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Z-Score", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title="Long Entry (+1.0)", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title="Short Entry (-1.0)", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Mean (0)", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title="Short Exit (+0.5)", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title="Long Exit (-0.5)", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(divergence_zscore)

# ROC comparison
timeseries_lines(
    title="EUR/USD vs GBP/USD Momentum (ROC)",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="EUR/USD ROC", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="GBP/USD ROC", color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(roc_eurusd, roc_gbpusd)

# Divergence raw
timeseries_lines(
    title="Raw Divergence (EUR/USD ROC - GBP/USD ROC)",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Divergence", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(divergence)

# ATR and inverse volatility weight
timeseries_lines(
    title="Volatility & Position Sizing",
    category="Risk Management",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ATR (20)", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Avg ATR (50)", color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(atr_20, avg_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="Inverse Volatility Weight",
    category="Risk Management",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Weight (capped)", color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title="Neutral", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title="Min Cap", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title="Max Cap", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(capped_weight)

# Summary cards
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Strategy Metrics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current Z-Score", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current ATR", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Position Weight", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Position Size %", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(divergence_zscore, atr_20, capped_weight, final_size)
